notes.title: New Features
items: Continue, skip, or abort paused merges, rebases, cherry-picks, reverts, and patch applications from the Git page
Shift-click commits to inspect their combined changes
Show binary file sizes in Git changes
Show progress while Git actions run
Recognize Gemini, Copilot, Qwen, and Kimi with brand marks
Open the Git tab with Option-Command-G

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: Keep tab group disclosure chevrons visible at the trailing edge
Center empty and error messages in diff views

notes.title: New Features
items: Stage and unstage individual hunks in the Git changes list
View diffs side by side and toggle full-file context
Drag tabs between groups and reorder groups in the sidebar
Run stash actions from the Git history context menu

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: Keep the titlebar background correct in compact mode
Show newly created stashes immediately and label stashes by their short OID

notes.title: New Features
items: Search terminal scrollback with live result counts and next or previous navigation
Generate commit messages from staged changes
Group Git branches by prefix and choose which branches appear in history
See line counts for each changed file

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: Improve Git history visibility for detached HEADs and shallow files
Reduce Git history flicker and make diff loading more reliable

notes.title: New Features
items: A dedicated Git workspace with history, changes, branches, tags, stashes, and diffs
Filter the sidebar by Git tabs and open Git from the command palette
Right-click changed files to edit, reveal in Finder, or copy their paths
Updated terminal themes and LLM model support

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: Improved Git state handling and localization across the app

notes.title: New Features
items: Focus is hidden from the sidebar when tab groups are off
The Other filter appears only when files or diffs are open

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: The Other filter returns to All after its last file or diff closes
The divider beside the inspector remains visible in full screen

notes.title: New Features
items: Use the terminal theme throughout the app
